messages:
Marco (Sourcing): Vendor update: H100 batch slipped to 10-14 weeks, and theyre allocating ~50% of our Q2 order. They also want to centralize RMAs via their EU consolidate hub by default.
Theo (Fleet): Oof. That cuts into our Oslo + SIN capacity plan. Any quick options to borrow spares from us-west for the short term?
Ava (Infra): We can shift some capacity but beware cross-batch firmware mismatches. If we move cards cross-region we need firmware parity and a 24h burn-in to avoid KV cache corruption.
Sam (EngOps): Short-term cloud-bursting for training sounds reasonable. For inference we should avoid touching prod nodes. Estimate: 2-3 weeks of burst capacity to bridge the gap.
Sofia (Logistics): EU RMA routing adds customs hops for APAC returns and ~4-6 days transit. I can request direct returns to our APAC depot but carrier costs jump ~25%.
Marco (Sourcing): @Sofia get an air vs sea cost delta and transit times. Also demand a serialized split-shipment plan with ETAs per tranche.
Sofia (Logistics): Vendor just replied: split ship possible — 35% immediate, 15% in 3 weeks, remainder 10-14 weeks. They asked if we want DHL express or consolidated sea.
Theo (Fleet): Prioritize express for any replacements destined for low-latency clusters. Sea ok for spares.
Ava (Infra): For any inbound replacements: mandatory burn-in script and firmware flash. Proposed check: `gpu-smoke --cycles 8 --mem --nvlink-test`. No direct prod seating until pass.
Sam (EngOps): I'll add tags and metrics: tag any shifted requests with `gpu_patch=vendor_gap_q2` and track cost delta per-hour.
Sofia (Logistics): Vendor wants RMAs returned within 72h of label creation, otherwise they wont escalate immediate replacements. Their RMA template wants serials and photos.
Marco (Sourcing): We should ask for a penalty or service credit for missed allocation SLAs. Any internal leverage?
Theo (Fleet): We can offer a 6-month reserved commit (instead of their requested 12mo) in exchange for better priority and shorter RMA SLAs.
Ava (Infra): Also insist on ship-to-firmware matching. If they cant match firmware, they must include vendor-flash image and a tech checklist.
Sam (EngOps): I'm pushing for serial-numbered replacements only. Bulk SKUs break our CMDB reconciliation.
Sofia (Logistics): I'll own RMA intake until resolved and publish a tracker. Columns: `our_serial`, `vendor_rma`, `awb`, `origin`, `dest`, `eta`, `status`.
Marco (Sourcing): Can someone own daily vendor sync? Need a single point to chase ETAs and credits.
Sofia (Logistics): I'll take vendor sync for two weeks and post the tracker at: https://files.redwood.example/rma/q2-h100-backfill (access: infra/logistics).
Theo (Fleet): Sending critical serials DM (FRA + OSL + SIN). Prioritize those for the immediate split.
VendorShipBot: AWB 987654321  Shipped: EU hub -> FRA depo, ETA +2d.
Ava (Infra): Reminder: incoming units must not be placed into production without passing the smoke script and firmware sync. I'll post a short checklist to #eng-infra.
Sam (EngOps): Draft runbook for RMA intake + burn-in checklist ready: https://playbooks.redwood.example/rma-intake. Will add rollback and CMDB reconciliation steps.
Marco (Sourcing): Vendor countered on credits: offer 1.5% credit if we take a 9-month term. Counter-proposal: 3-month min or 6-month at 1% credit. Thoughts?
Theo (Fleet): Push for 3-6 months. 9 months locks us too long with uncertain roadmap.
Sofia (Logistics): Also push them to waive EU consolidation for RMAs, or at least give us the option per-ship.
Marco (Sourcing): I'll send the counter now. Action items: @Sofia own RMA intake and vendor sync, @Theo send priority serials, @Ava publish burn-in checklist and canary routing, @Sam finalize runbook, I'll keep negotiating credits/commit. Check-in EOD tomorrow.
Sofia (Logistics): Tracker uploaded and shared.
Theo (Fleet): Sent serials list.
Ava (Infra): Canary routing draft posted for review in #eng-infra.
Sam (EngOps): Runbook updated with tagging and billing notes.
Marco (Sourcing): Vendor replied: cant meet 3-month priority without a 6mo commit. Keeping the negotiation open. Will update here.
